description: Approval holds (spec/command-metadata.md, "Approvals") against a backend started with APPROVALS=agents, where todo-clear, the one change nothing undoes, is held for any caller that is not a person and an MCP caller is an agent. Each case names the client it needs: "acknowledge" declares no elicitation, so a held call fails with APPROVAL_REQUIRED; "accept" and "decline" declare form elicitation, so the server asks the person, and the client answers every question that way. The runner resets the live list with todo-delete-batch, since a clear would be held; "then" checks the state afterwards. TypeScript implements approvals so far; the others follow in the to-do reference plan's phase 5.

tests.name: An agent's clear is held
tests.description: With no one to ask, the clear fails before anything is removed, with a suggestion to ask the person

tests.name: A delete is not held
tests.description: A delete can be undone with todo-restore, so it runs without approval

tests.name: An approved clear runs
tests.description: The server asks the person, who approves, and the clear removes the completed todo

tests.name: A declined clear does not run
tests.description: The server asks the person, who declines, and nothing is removed
